---
title: "Animations"
resources:
  - gift_raw.json
---

Every icon ships with one or more animations. These arguments control when an animation plays, which one plays, and how it plays.

## Trigger

The `trigger` argument controls which event plays an icon's animation. The supported values are `in`, `click`, `hover`, `loop`, `loop-on-hover`, `morph`, `boomerang`, and `sequence`. With no `trigger`, the icon simply rests on its first frame.

| Shortcode                            | Icon                             |
|--------------------------------------|----------------------------------|
| `{{{< li jjoolpwc >}}}` *(no trigger)* | {{< li jjoolpwc >}} |
| `{{{< li jjoolpwc trigger=in >}}}` | {{< li jjoolpwc trigger=in >}} |
| `{{{< li jjoolpwc trigger=click >}}}` | {{< li jjoolpwc trigger=click >}} |
| `{{{< li jjoolpwc trigger=hover >}}}` | {{< li jjoolpwc trigger=hover >}} |
| `{{{< li jjoolpwc trigger=loop >}}}` | {{< li jjoolpwc trigger=loop >}} |
| `{{{< li jjoolpwc trigger=loop-on-hover >}}}` | {{< li jjoolpwc trigger=loop-on-hover >}} |
| `{{{< li jjoolpwc trigger=morph >}}}` | {{< li jjoolpwc trigger=morph >}} |
| `{{{< li jjoolpwc trigger=boomerang >}}}` | {{< li jjoolpwc trigger=boomerang >}} |

## State

Many icons bundle several named animation **states**. Select one with the `state` argument (browse an icon's states on the [lordicon.com](https://lordicon.com) website). For local files, `state` needs a **Raw** export, which carries every animation; the smaller **Minified** export keeps only the one chosen in the editor. See [Source](index.qmd#source).

| Shortcode                             | Icon                             |
|---------------------------------------|----------------------------------|
| `{{{< li laqlvddb trigger=morph state=morph-mantion >}}}` | {{< li laqlvddb trigger=morph state=morph-mantion >}} |
| `{{{< li laqlvddb trigger=morph state=morph-neighbourhood >}}}` | {{< li laqlvddb trigger=morph state=morph-neighbourhood >}} |
| `{{{< li laqlvddb trigger=loop state=loop-3d-roll >}}}` | {{< li laqlvddb trigger=loop state=loop-3d-roll >}} |
| `{{{< li laqlvddb trigger=loop state=loop-smoke >}}}` | {{< li laqlvddb trigger=loop state=loop-smoke >}} |

## Delay

Looping animations can pause between each loop for a set number of milliseconds using the `delay` argument.

| Shortcode                             | Icon                             |
|---------------------------------------|----------------------------------|
| `{{{< li laqlvddb trigger=loop  >}}}` | {{< li laqlvddb trigger=loop >}} |
| `{{{< li laqlvddb trigger=loop delay=3000 >}}}` | {{< li laqlvddb trigger=loop delay=3000 >}} |

## Speed

The `speed` argument multiplies the playback rate. Values below `1` play in slow motion; values above `1` play faster.

| Shortcode                             | Icon                             |
|---------------------------------------|----------------------------------|
| `{{{< li laqlvddb trigger=loop speed=0.5 >}}}` | {{< li laqlvddb trigger=loop speed=0.5 >}} |
| `{{{< li laqlvddb trigger=loop >}}}` | {{< li laqlvddb trigger=loop >}} |
| `{{{< li laqlvddb trigger=loop speed=2 >}}}` | {{< li laqlvddb trigger=loop speed=2 >}} |

## Sequence

The `sequence` trigger chains states, plays, and delays together into a custom scenario defined by the `sequence` argument. Steps are separated by commas: `state:NAME` selects an animation, `play` (or `play:reverse`) runs it, and `delay:MS` pauses. The available state names come from the icon's own markers.

| Shortcode                             | Icon                             |
|---------------------------------------|----------------------------------|
| `{{{< lif gift_raw.json trigger=sequence sequence="state:hover-squeeze,play,delay:500,state:hover-roll,play,delay:500" >}}}` | {{< lif gift_raw.json trigger=sequence sequence="state:hover-squeeze,play,delay:500,state:hover-roll,play,delay:500" >}} |
